en.headline: Tai Kwun film exhibition closes on Sunday
en.dek: Better Together, on Hong Kong cinema's team spirit, runs at Tai Kwun's Duplex Studio until 4 October, with tickets at HK$30.
body: Tai Kwun's exhibition Better Together — Partnering Up for Hong Kong Movies closes on Sunday, 4 October. The Hong Kong Jockey Club lists the run from 23 June to 4 October at the Duplex Studio in Block 01, 10 Hollywood Road, Central, open from 11am to 7pm.

The Jockey Club, which is presenting the show with Tai Kwun, describes it as a look at how Hong Kong filmmakers worked in pairs and crews across decades of local cinema. The listed display includes on-screen props, recreated action scenes, and accounts from action teams and filmmakers on how effects were staged.
Regular tickets are HK$30 and concession tickets HK$20, according to the Jockey Club listing. Sunday is the final day.

zh.headline: 大館香港電影展覽周日結束
zh.dek: 「拍住上」展覽在中環荷李活道十號大館一號館複式展室展至十月四日，普通票三十元。
body: 大館展覽「拍住上：香港電影中的團隊精神」將於十月四日（星期日）結束。香港賽馬會列出的展期為六月二十三日至十月四日，地點是中環荷李活道十號大館一號館複式展室，開放時間為上午十一時至下午七時。
賽馬會與大館合辦是次展覽，介紹本地電影人數十年來如何以拍檔和團隊形式拍片。列出的展品包括曾在銀幕出現的道具、重現的動作場面，以及動作組和電影人講述特技如何拍攝。
賽馬會資料顯示，普通票三十元，優惠票二十元。星期日是最後一天。
